name: One Page Checkout COD
author: Iheb HAFDALLAH

sections.description:
One Page Checkout COD allows you to turn any single product page into a one-page checkout experience. Users can fill out billing, shipping, and payment information directly on the product page, reducing friction and increasing conversion rates.

Features:
* Display WooCommerce checkout form using the shortcode: [one_page_checkout]
* Compatible with Elementor, Divi, and standard WooCommerce themes
* Fully translatable (i18n ready)
* Lightweight and fast, loading resources only when needed
* Secure code using WordPress and WooCommerce APIs
* GDPR compliant – does not track users without consent

Support

Please use the WordPress.org support forums for help and reporting issues.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or transmit any user data externally. All data is handled locally via WooCommerce and WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/one-page-checkout directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [one_page_checkout] on any page or post to display the checkout form.
  4. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
sections.faq:
How do I display the one-page checkout?

Use the shortcode [one_page_checkout] in any page, post, or widget area.

Is this compatible with Elementor/Divi?

Yes, this plugin works with Elementor, Divi, and all standard WooCommerce themes.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

No, WooCommerce must be installed and activated. The plugin will not load if WooCommerce is not active.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes, the plugin does not track users or send data externally without consent.
